name: Vault 21: House Gambit
oracle_text:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I, II — Discard a card, then draw a card.
III — Reveal up to five nonland cards from your hand. For each of those cards that has the same mana value as another card revealed this way, create a Treasure token.
blocked_sentences: III — Reveal up to five nonland cards from your hand. For each of those cards that has the same mana value as another card revealed this way, create a Treasure token.

needs.what: a selector (or value) over a bound set of revealed cards that matches each card whose mana value equals that of at least one OTHER card in the same set, so a `for_each`/`count` over a chosen-and-revealed `as` binding of up to five nonland hand cards can create one Treasure per matching card; the reveal also needs a player choice of up to N cards from hand
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `reveal` takes only `objects` and `as` with no up-to-N choice from hand; the selector has `shares_a_name_with`/`shares_a_color_with`/`shares_a_type_with` but no mana-value analogue, and `distinct` (number of distinct mana values) does not give the count of cards whose mana value is duplicated (e.g. MVs 1,1,2 should give 2 Treasures; count minus distinct gives 1)
